messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: smart-routing fallback loop detected for customers calling /v1/generate in eu-west-1. Rate of retries to fallback model variant increasing; elevated 500s and latency spikes. Pager: oncall_ryan.
oncall_ryan: Got the page. Investigating now. Can someone drop initial symptoms?
maria: Seeing a cascade: requests from eu-west routed to us-east then back to eu-west repeatedly. We have multiple fallback events per request. 5xx rate up ~12% for eu customers.
luis: Logs show fallback_policy selected "variant: small-quant" for eu-west but that variant isn't compatible with seq_len > 2048 -> runtime errors. Fallback triggered -> region reroute -> routing policy flips -> loop.
simran: Confirmed error in runtime logs: "KV cache overflow" + "unsupported quantized kernel" for small-quant.
oncall_ryan: OK immediate mitigation: disabling smart-routing fallback policy for eu-west and pinning active model to the last known-good variant. Applying now.
eng-ops: Applying flags: `redwood.routing.smart_fallback.enabled: false (eu-west)` and `redwood.routing.pin_model_variant[euw]: large-v2`
eng-ops: Done. Traffic is re-routing to pinned variant. 5xx rate dropping. Latency returning to baseline for most requests.
oncall_ryan: Paging update -> incident severity lowered. Handing over to Maria for postmortem and monitoring for 30m. @kate please notify impacted customers.
kate: Will draft a brief: EU customers experienced degraded throughput and 500s for ~18 minutes; root cause suspected fallback misconfig + incompatible variant selection. Sharing draft in #customer-impact in 5.
jen: FYI CS reported 3 escalations. Offering credits if they want.
maria: Action items from triage: 1) Fix policy rules so incompatible model variants are never chosen as fallbacks. 2) Add explicit route_tag and decision_log fields to every routing decision. 3) Add guard that prevents region fallback loops (detect >2 region hops per request). 4) Postmortem and timeline.
luis: Reproduced the policy YAML that caused it. Snippet:```yaml
fallback_policy:
  - if: model_unavailable
    action:
      type: fallback
      variant: small-quant
      region_preference: [eu-west-1, us-east-1]
```
maria: The bug: small-quant was listed even though model capabilities metadata marks it as "max_seq_len: 2048" while live requests are 4096. Routing engine lacked capability check in fallback path.
simran: Observability gaps we hit: decision_log entries were emitted but missing `route_tag` and `variant_origin` fields. Hard to correlate which policy branch ran. Also no hop count in trace.
oncall_ryan: For immediate observability fix: enable transient debug logging for routing decisions in eu-west for next 6 hours and add a short-term metric `routing.hop_count` to SLI dashboard.
eng-ops: Added debug flag and hop_count metric. Dashboards updated.
maria: I'll own the postmortem. We need a fix PR to validate capabilities during fallback selection + a linter rule to block configured fallbacks that mismatch model metadata. Assign to eng-ml.
luis: Taking the model validation PR. Will also add a policy unit test that simulates long-ctx requests.
eng-ops: Recommend a long-term change: make fallback selections reference a whitelist of compatible variants (derived from model manifest) and remove free-text variant names in policy UI.
kate: Customer comms draft posted. Waiting on final severity note.
jen: Logging: saved sample request ids for impacted customers -> will attach to ticket for CS.
maria: Handoff done. oncall_ryan, if anything else spikes ping the incident channel. I'll start the timeline doc and follow-up tasks.
oncall_ryan: Acknowledged. Thanks team.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated -> routing fallback disabled for eu-west; monitoring in progress. Please escalate per playbook if errors rise above threshold.
